generator_real: reuse discriminator real batch, matching archived public K3P baseline
initialization: seed 0; original public baseline construction order; no external fixture

noise_policy.latent: candidate declaration; per-update bandwidth in policy log

protocol.purpose: Shared finite evaluations of a learner intended to continue indefinitely; these budgets and target changes are not learner inputs.

fixture.initialization: Networks initialize on CPU, then move to CUDA; prior construction and RNG streams follow the public worker. Verify initial model and RNG hashes.
fixture.generator_real: Reuse the discriminator real batch, matching the public baseline.
fixture.candidate_noise_policy: Declared by each unchanged candidate, with no dependency on evaluator budget or target-change times. Do not silently retain the old horizon-based noise schedule.

observation.stream: Isolated evaluation generator, using the existing public-worker convention; never advances training streams.
report: Initial acquisition time and retention through each target change
First passing observation after every change and its update delay
Every subsequent failing observation before the next target change or evaluation end
Passing and total observations since first arrival, with minimum HQ and mode count
Final uninterrupted passing suffix, explicitly retrospective and separate from first arrival
All applied learning rates, noise, controller state and any automatic reopening decisions
Finite-window non-arrival as not observed, not proof that arrival is impossible

single_shift.frozen_control: Copy full learner state at the change and sample without further optimizer updates.

stationary.purpose: Measure retention and unnecessary automatic reopening under ordinary minibatch noise.

delayed_repeated.purpose: Same data-change times as the historical stress declaration, with the corrected arrival/stability interpretation.

long_continuation.purpose: One uninterrupted run with a long settled interval before another late target change. Report the 9000-update prefix separately.

qualification.checkpoint_continuation: Separate exact continuation check covering models, optimizer, controller, EMA, RNG and caller-owned data-stream state. Do not reload during the uninterrupted long run.
qualification.horizon_independence: Compare an identical training prefix under different evaluator budgets; the learner must not receive either budget.
qualification.matched_k3p: Use the same public architecture, initialization, data and runtime. Explicitly declare K3P's historical scheduled baseline; its scores are reference evidence, not eligibility.
qualification.broader_quality: Complete the surviving exact candidate's own 22-task quality coverage at existing declared seeds; no seed sweeps or inherited ancestor passes.
qualification.success: Supervisor must assess retention, arrival and subsequent stability across all required evidence. No single endpoint, retrospective suffix, raw deadline count or successful process exit establishes qualification.
qualification.infinite_time_claim: Finite evidence supports an indefinite-use design; it cannot prove literal infinite stability.

mechanism.mechanism: Compact learned latent cells: replace standard Gaussian local coordinates with independent uniform[-1,1] coordinates. Perturbation is bandwidth EMA times softplus(log_width)/log2 times uniform coordinates. Coordinates have variance1/3 and bounded support; no tunable multiplier. Preserve DV14 antithetic width-gradient estimator and corrected data/game critic-memory binding.
mechanism.motivation: DV14 re-earned unequal_mass PASS14/24 final14, covariance error.275462/eigenratio.795536, but bars4 FAIL8/24 final0 with finalHQ.84375 and learned widths.522–1.274. Antithetic estimation alone did not repair image fidelity. Test compact local support so a stochastic sample cannot make an arbitrarily large excursion across learned mappings. Removing Gaussian tails is a hypothesis, not a proven causal diagnosis; lower coordinate variance may lose vector spread and must be measured.
mechanism.initialization: Canonical G,D,z tensors and RNG unchanged; additional log_width zeros. Existing KA2 799-call critic-reference initialization calibrates one reference and never ends learning; all later control remains reversible without a horizon.
mechanism.noise: Critic input0 and output Gaussian.029 constant. Latent noise now uniform[-1,1] per coordinate, variance1/3, generated with torch.rand from the same private noise stream, one Bxd draw per D/G generation. Paired width pass clones pre-G noise state, reverses uniform perturbation, and reuses output noise without advancing any training/global RNG. Observations use the same compact law and isolated streams. No task-dependent branch, target statistics, schedules or fitted noise law.
mechanism.state: Width parameters, native Adam moments, EMA widths, bandwidth, recent applied widths/RMS and data/game controller are checkpointed; trainer/caller RNG unchanged. Sampling does not mutate learner state.
mechanism.signals: 32 normalized fixed projection linear/sin/cos fast.1 slow.01 real-data temporal features with covariance-normalized difference; scalar mobility only. Separate EMA.02 payoff drives cold mobility, unexplained critic Adam-gradient surprise brakes self drift, critic factor1/(1+payoff_error^2). No direct target fitting, centers, labels, task IDs, quality, endpoint or change notices.
mechanism.protocol: Byte-identical shared evaluation-protocols.json and COMMON.md. Full cold4600 ring first; unequal_mass and bars4 before expansion; survivors stationary7500, uninterrupted30000 with9000 prefix, own22, budget prefix and fresh-process continuation. Every started fixed window completes.
mechanism.deviations: A single new compact noise law replaces Gaussian on every task; variance changes by its mathematical definition, not a coefficient sweep. Existing G/D/z initialization and extra zero width initialization, optimizers, paired estimator, streams and unchanged frozen thresholds stay as DV14. Exact data/game binding retained. All own scores required.
mechanism.computation: Same O(Nd+Bd) latent work/storage and one extra G/critic forward plus width-only gradient as DV14; no particle-pair search.

evaluation.criterion: time to reach shifted target, then measured stability; no 81/81 gate
